name: typeorm
description: TypeORM with the postgres driver, through DataSource.transaction() and repositories, with EntitySchema entities.

modes.description: TypeORM's defaults, with the managed transaction API ds.transaction(callback).

unsupported.TX-04.independent-inner: TypeORM has no propagation modes: a nested manager.transaction() is always a savepoint, and an independent transaction is an unrelated ds.transaction() on another connection, which this case does not test.
